idiom_name: enum + match with compiler-enforced exhaustiveness (error E0004)
implementation_notes: Rust enums are data-carrying sum types and match is the elimination form: the compiler requires the arm set to be exhaustive and reports the missing pattern as error E0004, so adding a variant breaks every match on it. Use if let, let else, while let and matches! for single-variant cases, match for total elimination, and the ? operator or combinators when a Result only needs propagation. Guards (Variant(x) if cond) do not count towards coverage, and #[non_exhaustive] on a public enum deliberately forces downstream matches to keep a wildcard arm - the documented trade of the coverage guarantee for forward compatibility.
pitfalls: A catch-all arm (_, or a binding such as other => ...) satisfies the compiler and disables the guarantee for every variant added later.
Matching by value moves non-Copy payloads out of the scrutinee; match on &s or use ref patterns when the value is still needed afterwards.
Guarded arms are not counted as coverage, so a guarded variant usually still needs a general arm - which can make the guarded arm effectively unreachable.
